findings.title: Mutable external workflow Action references
findings.root_cause: 389 direct uses references tracked movable version tags rather than immutable reviewed commits.
changes: Same major-version official tag commits pinned; no version upgrades.
Recursive Action/reusable-workflow/composite guard added to pipeline-contracts.
Cache contracts updated to require matching immutable restore/save revisions.
evidence: 15 local pin/cache/native tests passed against merged main.
Production native collector used pinned checkout/setup and passed parser tests; provider denial remained visible.
findings.limitation: Direct repository Action references verified; transitive dependencies inside external actions not fully audited.

findings.title: Automatic paid diagnostic requests triggered by workflow edits
findings.root_cause: Four existing diagnostic workflows had push path triggers for their own YAML. PR467 pin edits triggered all four. This violated the current no-paid-call constraint.
findings.head: be2f93bd397572c145b563527c3e5b1a039ce9ee
findings.after_proposed: All four workflows manual-only with default-false explicit paid authorization; all four Python entry points refuse network by default; schema import network-free. No further paid validation calls.
findings.tests: 10 offline production contracts pass, including no-network behavior with a key present. Full 222 command contract suite accounted for after installing two missing local test libraries and rerunning five affected commands.
findings.blocker: Latest two GitHub checks are action_required, page explicitly says awaiting maintainer approval; retry endpoint HTTP403 says workflow cannot be retried. Connector exposes no workflow-approval action; no authenticated local gh. Earlier revision passed CI but does not certify final revision.
findings.required_user_action: Approve pending workflows on PR471, then final checks and merge can proceed. Do not rerun paid diagnostic jobs.

findings.title: Refresh health showed old paid telemetry instead of native failure
findings.root_cause: Native collector did not update the legacy paid refresh-health artifact on success or exception.
findings.authorship: Existing concurrent repairs reviewed and carried forward; not authored in this cycle.
findings.before: Refresh health still dated19:12:37, paid-source charged10, while retained real native board was observed20:49:23.
findings.verification: Failure-only publication succeeded; public JSON observed at21:20:19 correctly reports HTTP403, no fresh quotes, preserved prior snapshot, zero native-call credits.

findings.title: Native source access and primary forecast coverage incomplete
findings.root_cause: GitHub-hosted public quote endpoint returns403; provider-side cause unconfirmed. Twenty current standard markets lack the validated minimum prior player history; nine affected players have2–7 usable games versus minimum8.
safe_actions: Checked actual current-form player history and prior-game dates.
Retained immutable originals, provenance, standard-only filters and honest failing gates.
No short-history research promotion or fabricated pretip grades.
findings.required_fix: Permitted no-cost provider access plus authentic eligible historical features, or independently validated short-history model. Do not evade provider access controls.
findings.historical_evidence: Uncaptured pretip evidence cannot be manufactured now; missing historical total not newly established.

findings.title: Concurrent artifact writes and legacy Pages cancellations
findings.root_cause: Numerous independent publishers commit to main, causing safe push retries to exhaust and native legacy Pages builds to supersede one another.
findings.recovery: Retried only two credit-free jobs after contention subsided; baseline freeze and separate research grading both succeeded. No paid workflow retries.
findings.required_user_action: Repository Settings > Pages > Build and deployment > Source > GitHub Actions; existing serialized controller supports this mode.
findings.access_blocker: GitHub connector has no Pages settings mutation. Local gh unauthenticated; previous same-session browser Settings probe was logged out. No secret or settings changes attempted through unauthorized access.
findings.limitation: Two successful retries are recovery, not proof that cross-workflow publication contention is permanently fixed.

findings.title: Next-slate quote captures unavailable
findings.root_cause: Tomorrow NBA schedule exists and forecasts exist, but verified pretip provider line captures are absent.
findings.required_fix: Obtain real standard pretip quotes through a permitted source before those games start; never mark forecast-only records as line-backed picks.
